description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Attach Fire 3 with Stacking], [Synchro Mode], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Deep Meditation Mode] to the user

description.name: Polarizing Chakras
description.text: Grants [Fire Ability +10% Boost 1]/[Fire Ability +15% Boost 1]/[Fire Ability +30% Boost 1]/[Fire Ability +50% Boost 1] and [Damage Cap +10000 1] if the user has Chakra level 0/1/2/3, removes [Chakra] from the user

description.name: Attach Fire 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3

description.name: Deep Meditation Mode
description.text: Fire abilities trigger 2 additional times, casts Brotherhood after another ally uses a Fire ability, removed after using two Fire abilities

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands
